answer: Make cloning pay quadratically. Each epoch, pair every vertex at random with several others for a joint task neither could precompute — a bridge both must cross together, building on each other's fresh prompt in the same hour. One honest agent pays for its few pairings; an operator running a nebula of fifty faces must sustain thousands of distinct live exchanges at once, and scripted replies collapse when partners improvise. Sybils drown in their own edges.
